_about: Safari zone record. The area carries encounterMode 'safari' — PROPOSED here as a sibling value in #110's field on #7's schema (one field, one landing edit, both packages cited). Populations are the area's ordinary #7 tables; the zone changes resolution, never what lives there. Capture is #38's math with battle terms removed BY CONSTRUCTION: the resolution record has no vitality field and no status field, so no safari attempt can read a weakened target.

closed_throw_vocabulary.offer: throw a bait-class item; the creature may approach / eat / stay
closed_throw_vocabulary.toss: throw the keeper instrument — a capture attempt
closed_throw_vocabulary.wait: do nothing; time passes, #152 behaviour plays

open_register: any zone's designation (owner ruling on a named area; none exists)
bait item roster + useContext.safari acceptance in #31's home
zone-issued instrument tiers (#38 tier-list shape; canon names no instruments)

resolution.pCondition: pBase x instrumentTier ONLY (vitalityFactor reads unweakened per #110; statusFactor neutral — the only legal value without a battle, per #38)

validation_rule: a zone record naming a Dark Forest area (surface or depths) is a DATA ERROR — the Forest is never a safari zone

thrownItems: #31 item ids legal to throw here — each must carry the PROPOSED useContext.safari flag in #31's home
